title: Architecture maturity assessment
body:
# Architecture maturity assessment — T9 TOGAF ADM capability (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Dimensions

The assessment covers the nine dimensions of SPEC_V2 §8.1: architecture process; architecture development; business linkage; senior-management involvement; operating-unit participation; architecture communication; IT security; architecture governance; and IT investment and acquisition strategy. Each is scored from 0 (none) to 5 (measured) per stage, with a date and evidence; the schema refuses a missing dimension, proved by `crates/api/tests/architecture_capability.rs::a_maturity_assessment_needs_every_dimension`.

## Scores

No measured score is claimed by this rework. P0's `maturity-assessment` document (MA-1) is the proposed baseline delivered by #122's A7 and states proposed for P0 acceptance (plan §2); it is not a measured `architecture_maturity` row, and this pass did not run `architecture.maturity_assess`. Reporting nine 0–5 scores here would invent a receipt. The action and its test prove the instrument exists; the measurement is a dated Board activity that this record leaves to the capability owner.

## Baseline

The baseline is therefore P0's proposed MA-1 content, not an adopted measurement. The plan's starting-state table records that no maturity row existed when T9 was built; the capability's own measurement is the first dated assessment the Board adopts. This document records that absence honestly rather than converting a proposal into a baseline.

## Milestones

The milestones are the development plan the Board approves with the baseline: one dated target per dimension, held by a tranche review. No milestone row is claimed here, because no baseline was adopted; the `architecture.maturity_plan` action is the mechanism, and a future assessment supplies the numbers. The open findings v1-p81-4 and v1-w2a-3 remain relevant because the Board that adopts the baseline must itself be approved and must resolve its adoption decision to a real approved record.
